notes: Recovered original symbol names mapped onto configured units by address. The recovered symbol list is grouped by original source file; sizes here are the distance to the next symbol in the same file (so never cross a named symbol of the same file). full = our unit is exactly the recovered function; fragment = the recovered function starts at our unit and continues past it; entry_size_unknown = the symbol is last in its source-file group; no_unit = the recovered symbol is not inside a configured non-matching C unit. Reference data only; not consumed by the build.
